products.name: Mehendi Booking
products.excerpt: Service-led mehendi booking with preferred date, time, area, and package details. Confirmation is subject to artist availability and advance payment.
products.description:
Professional mehendi booking service for bridal, engagement, party, and event occasions in Dhaka city. Customers can submit their preferred date, time, location, and package requirements through the booking request form.
After receiving the request, our team will review artist availability, area, timing, and design scope before confirming the service. The final package and price may vary depending on design complexity, number of hands or guests, and total service duration.
An advance payment of BDT 1,000 is required after confirmation to reserve the booking slot. The remaining amount can be paid after the service is completed. Extra charges may apply for additional guests, complex bridal designs, extended hours, or locations outside the service area.

service_product_meta.booking_notes:
This booking is for a professional bridal mehendi service in Dhaka city. Brides can request their preferred date, time, area, design style, and package details before confirming the service.

The service includes detailed bridal mehendi design based on the selected package or requested scope. Brides may choose traditional, modern, floral, Arabic, full-hand, feet mehendi, or customized bridal designs. Final pricing and duration may vary depending on design complexity, coverage area, number of hands/feet, and any additional family or guest requirements.

After submitting the request, our team will review artist availability, event date, location, and design scope before confirming the booking.
service_product_meta.confirmation_note:
Submitting a booking request does not confirm the service immediately. After receiving the request, our team will check artist availability, preferred date, time, location, and package details.

Once the booking is approved, an advance payment of BDT 1,000 is required to reserve the bridal mehendi slot. The remaining amount can be paid after the service is completed.
service_product_meta.available_areas:
Dhaka city, including Gulshan, Banani, Bashundhara, Uttara, Dhanmondi, Mirpur, Mohammadpur, Baily Road, Wari, Motijheel, and nearby areas.

For locations outside Dhaka city, availability and extra travel charges must be confirmed before booking.
service_product_meta.time_slot_options:
Available by appointment only.

Preferred time slots:
Morning: 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM
Afternoon: 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM
Evening: 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM

Final time slot depends on artist availability and event schedule.
service_product_meta.extra_charge_note:
Extra charges may apply for locations outside the regular service area, additional guests, extended working hours, very detailed bridal designs, feet mehendi, or last-minute booking requests.

Any extra charge will be discussed and confirmed before the final booking.

service_product_meta.gallery_intro_text: Explore our bridal mehendi design gallery for inspiration. From elegant traditional patterns to detailed full-hand bridal designs, each look can be customized based on the bride’s personal style, wedding theme, and selected package.

service_product_meta.booking_notes:
Our Bridal Mehendi Booking Service is designed for brides who want elegant, detailed, and long-lasting mehendi for their wedding events. Customers can request their preferred date, time, location, and design style through the booking form.

This service includes bridal mehendi design for hands and/or feet based on the selected package. Brides may choose traditional, modern, floral, Arabic, portrait-inspired, full-hand, or customized bridal designs. The final price and duration may vary depending on design complexity, coverage area, and any additional requirements.

After receiving the booking request, our team will review artist availability, event date, location, and design scope before confirming the service. Once confirmed, an advance payment is required to reserve the bridal mehendi slot.

What’s Included:
Bridal mehendi artist service, design discussion, mehendi application, required mehendi materials, and basic aftercare guidance.

Booking Note:
For bridal bookings, please mention your preferred design type, event date, number of hands/feet, location, and any special requirements in the notes section.
Flexible event-ready booking flow without mandatory deposit.
